summary.zh: 亚洲最重要的粮食作物，稻田四季景观是旅途最常见的农田植物景观。
summary.en: Asia's staple grain; paddy landscapes are among the most common farmland scenes on a trip.

field_marks.zh: 丛生草本，叶线形，圆锥花序，成熟时垂穗；田间常见水层与整齐的插秧行。
field_marks.en: Tufted grass with linear leaves and drooping panicles when ripe; usually seen in flooded, evenly planted rows.

story.zh: 稻是禾本科中最早完成基因组测序的作物之一，驯化过程发生在长江流域一带，距今约 9000 年。本条目的驯化年代为概述，需要进一步文献核对。
story.en: Rice was among the first crop genomes sequenced; domestication is placed in the Yangtze valley roughly 9,000 years ago. The date here is a summary and needs a primary-literature check.

notes.zh: 插秧 5–6 月，绿浪 7–8 月，金黄成熟 9–10 月。梯田区域雨季路滑，勿踩田埂。
notes.en: Transplanting May–June, green waves July–August, golden harvest September–October. Terraces are slippery in the wet season; do not walk on the bunds.
